title: S1310 (2019 Regular): Minors Posting Firearms on Social Media

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-02-22; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2019/1310/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 1924638))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2019-02-22); no vote recorded. Quotes under Sections 2 and 3 are list items within longer sentences.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new s. 790.111(1), F.S.): A minor who posts or publishes a picture of a firearm, a BB gun, an air or a gas-operated gun, or a device displayed to resemble a firearm to a social media page, post, profile, or account that is openly viewable to the public commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.
Section 1 (new s. 790.111(3), F.S.): Any firearm that is possessed or used by a minor in violation of this section shall be promptly seized by a law enforcement officer and disposed of in accordance with s. 790.08.
Section 2 (s. 790.174(2)(c), F.S.): On a social media page, post, profile, or account openly viewable to the public in violation of s. 790.111.
Section 3 (s. 901.15(17), F.S.): There is probable cause to believe that the person has committed a criminal act as described in s. 790.111.
